findings.text: follow-on: _finding_dispose_commands renders the same crew dispose --kind folded|exempted command pair, with near-identical placeholder prose, that reckon/crew/obligations.py:1218,1228 already renders for a sub-floor duty; the two spell the flag and the placeholders independently, so a change to the CLI option or the wording leaves one of them promising a command the other no longer accepts — the refusal's own claim to print 'the command that lifts the refusal' has no shared source with the CLI.

follow-on: the landed guard reads the run review's dispositions, but the repair path that answers those findings never writes one — only crew dispose does (reckon/crew_run_commands.py:711 is the sole caller of review_dispositions.record_finding_disposition) — so an automatic repair round leaves the reviewed run's earlier review reading open and its re-review at the repaired head is refused until a coordinator disposes by hand. The live plan's §2 states this remedy ('the repair path records each of them as folded into that round') and it is not implemented in the reviewed tree; the fix belongs in reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py, outside this node's fence.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete at 492418fb, commits 37abd242+492418fb, baseline_suite (negative-control.log, 1 failure, EXIT=1), after_suite (gate-head.log, 0 failures, EXIT=0) and 3 new tests, and it claims ruff-clean in its checkpoint line without a log.

justifications.durability: reinstating the regression — restoring reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py to its base revision with the new tests in place — makes tests/test_a_review_waits_for_its_repair.py:252 fail (negative-control.log, EXIT=1), and test_the_refusal_lifts_when_the_review_is_no_longer_open proves the refusal reads review_lifecycle's _run_open rather than a second derivation.
justifications.evidence: the gate the done_when names ran and its result is recorded — gate-head.log 52 passed EXIT=0 and negative-control.log 1 failed EXIT=1 at tests/test_a_review_waits_for_its_repair.py:252 — but the done_when's ruff-clean arm is claimed in the manifest checkpoint with no log, so I re-ran ruff myself on the two changed paths rather than read a recorded result.
justifications.fit: the new names are mechanism-descriptive (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2113 _open_review_refusal, :2075 _undisposed_blocking_findings), carry no plan or ticket identifier, and the module's local-import and refusal-dict idiom is followed.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2113 refuses a round whose newest review reads open, names every undisposed finding with its dispose command, composes nothing, and leaves plan reviews and review nodes alone, which is the goal exactly.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the owners the plan named — review_lifecycle.lifecycle, repair.blocking_finding_dispositions, review.stored_records_for_run and _record_review_dispatch — so no derivation is forked, though reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2089 renders the same folded/exempted dispose command pair that reckon/crew/obligations.py:1218 already renders for a duty.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the ac17ed13..492418fb diff is inside the fence declared at prompt.txt (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, the test module, the landing fragment), and the change carries nothing the goal does not imply.
